purpose: Prevent deterministic source/entity canonicalization from conflating active Mundari with the retired Glottolog Munda bookkeeping entry while preserving source, rights, and evidence-promotion boundaries.

retired_identity.name: Munda
retired_identity.glottolog_note_observed: entry retired; Glottolog notes historical Ethnologue Munda and Mundari entries are part of the same language and points to Mundari unr

canonicalization_rule.rule: Never rewrite an observed mund1321/unx historical or bookkeeping citation into a mund1320/unr source assertion without retaining the original identifier and provenance. For current language joins, use mund1320/unr as the active Glottolog identity.
canonicalization_rule.wals_bhumij_overlap_warning: Do not collapse WALS Bhumij into Mundari merely because WALS displays mund1320/unr for that lect; preserve WALS lect identity separately.
